description: This photograph depicts a natural or semi-natural coniferous forest ecosystem nestled within a rugged, mountainous landscape. The immediate foreground features arid, reddish-brown rocky outcrops with sparse, dry scrub vegetation. A dense, verdant coniferous forest occupies the middle ground, filling a deep valley or ravine and extending across its slopes. The background reveals additional distant, rocky hills and mountains under a bright sky. The image visually exemplifies the "Natural & semi-natural coniferous forest" land cover type, where coniferous species are the predominant vegetation, as defined within the document's section 3.2.1.
